entries.source: Engaged in automated repairs, preventing any action but increasing life regen by %d, all resistances by %d%% and preventing death until falling below -%d life.
entries.target: 进入自动修复模式，无法行动，但生命恢复速率增加 %d，全部抗性提升 %d%%，且生命值降至 -%d 以下前不会死亡。

entries.source: This gun has an absurdly long barrel. You wonder for whom it may have been designed.
entries.target: 这把枪的枪管长得出奇。你好奇这杆枪到底是为谁设计的。

entries.source: The target has been impregnated with %d developing ritch larvae which are feeding on it%s.  After a %d turn gestation period, each will burst out violently, dealing %0.2f physical and %0.2f fire damage to its host.
entries.target: 目标被 %d 个里奇幼虫寄生%s。在%d回合的发育期结束后，每个幼虫都会从寄主体内猛烈破体而出，对宿主造成 %0.2f 物理和 %0.2f 火焰伤害。

entries.source: Hovering in place, gaining %d%% evasion, %d%% movement speed and launching a powerful rocket barrage each turn.
entries.target: 目标悬浮在空中，获得 %d%% 躲闪概率，%d%% 移动速度，并每回合发射一轮强力火箭弹幕。

entries.source:
Using your Block talent surrounds you and your minions in a static barrier for 4 turns, increasing all resistances by %d%%. If an enemy deals damage to you or your minions, the barrier will shock them for %d%% of your shield damage.
		This effect cannot damage the same target more than once per turn, and will not interact with Counterstrike.
You now also use your Cunning in place of Strength when equipping shields as well as when calculating shield damage.
entries.target:
当你使用格挡技能的时候，你会在自己和召唤物身边产生一个静电屏障，增加所有抗性 %d%%， 持续 4 回合。如果有敌人对你或召唤物造成伤害，屏障会电击它们，造成 %d%% 盾牌伤害。
		这一效果每回合对同一目标最多造成一次伤害，且不会与反击效果相互作用。
装备盾牌时，你以灵巧代替力量满足属性需求；计算盾牌伤害时，也以灵巧代替力量。

entries.source:
Trigger an array of small mirrors to appear all over your cloak.
		The mirrors are positioned to reflect all light shining on you, granting %d stealth power for 10 turns.
		Stealth power increases with your steampower.
entries.target:
在披风上布满细小的反射镜阵列，反射照射到你身上的所有光线。
		获得 %d 潜行强度，持续 10 回合。
		潜行强度受蒸汽强度加成。

entries.source:
A powerful salve that makes you more resilient to physical, mental and magic effects and grants increased healing.
To be used with the medical injector implant.
entries.target:
一种强大的药剂，能增强你对物理、精神和魔法效果的抵抗能力，并增加你的治疗效果。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

entries.source: Summons a clone for %d turns which casts all the spells you cast, dealing %d%% damage and having %d%% health. Additionally, all light damage the clone deals becomes darkness damage and all darkness damage becomes light damage.
entries.target: 召唤一个镜像，持续 %d 回合。镜像会施放你施放的所有法术，造成 %d%% 的伤害，并拥有 %d%% 的生命值。此外，镜像造成的所有光伤害转换为暗影伤害，所有暗影伤害转换为光伤害。

entries.source:
You send a small steam-powered flying grapple to a target. The drone is homing so if the target moves it will follow.
		When it reaches its target it deploys grapples in all directions around it in radius 4.
		The grapples latch onto any foes and pull them toward the target. If they are stopped by a creature (or the target) both them and the creature take %0.2f physical damage.
entries.target:
向目标发射一枚小型蒸汽动力飞爪无人机。无人机会自动追踪，目标移动时会跟随。
		命中目标后，无人机朝周围 4 码范围内的各个方向发射金属飞爪。
		飞爪会抓住范围内任何敌人，并将它们向目标拉扯。如果被其他生物（或目标本身）阻挡，两者均受到 %0.2f 物理伤害。

entries.source:
Using your sheer arcane power you keep breaches in spacetime open for %d turns.
		Each turn they are open you project an occult clone of your saw along each breach, damaging any creature caught for %d%% occult weapon damage.
		The saw cuts both in a physical and arcane way, reducing the duration of a random beneficial effect on each target by %d each time.
		Each target can only be affected once per turn.
		This spell is only usable for one turn after casting Reality Breach but any Reality Breach cast during its duration is also recorded inside.
entries.target:
你调动强大的奥术力量，在时空中切开的裂缝会保持开放，持续 %d 回合。
		在这一裂缝打开的每一回合里，裂缝中会投射出你链锯的玄机克隆，对所有被击中的生物造成 %d%% 玄机武器伤害。
		这把链锯会同时进行物理和奥术层面的切割，每次击中会降低目标身上一个随机增益效果的持续时间 %d 回合。
		每个目标每回合只会被这一效果影响一次。
		此法术只能在施放现实切裂后的下一回合使用，但它持续期间施放的任何现实切裂也会被记录其中。

entries.source: Use steam powered engines to tilt the battle in your favour.
entries.target: 使用蒸汽动力引擎让战局向对你有利的方向倾斜。

entries.source:
You fire an incredibly potent shot at an enemy, doing %d%% damage and dazing them for %d turns.
		The daze chance increases with your Steampower.
entries.target:
你向一个敌人射出一发威力无穷的子弹，造成 %d%% 伤害并眩晕目标 %d 回合。
		眩晕几率受蒸汽强度加成。

entries.source: Increases steamsaw damage multiplier by %d%%.
entries.target: 使蒸汽链锯伤害倍率提高 %d%%。

entries.source:
Instantly grow a moss circle of radius %d at target area.
		Each turn the moss deals %0.2f nature damage to each foe within its radius.
		This moss is very thick and sticky causing all foes passing through it have their movement speed reduced by %d%% and have a %d%% chance to be pinned to the ground for 4 turns.
		The moss lasts %d turns.
		Moss talents are instant but place all other moss talents on cooldown for 3 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
瞬间在半径 %d 码的区域内长出苔藓圈。
		每回合苔藓会对其中的敌人造成 %0.2f 的自然伤害。
		这些又厚又粘的苔藓会让穿过其中的敌人移动速度下降 %d%% 并且有 %d%% 的几率被定身 4 回合。
		苔藓能持续 %d 回合。
		苔藓技能都是瞬发的，但是会让其他的苔藓技能进入冷却 3 回合。
		伤害受精神强度加成。

entries.source: Next melee or ranged attack that deals more than 8%% of maximum life is reduced by %d%% and triggers a radius %d conal explosion dealing %d%% steamgun damage. %d stacks remaining.
entries.target: 下一次受到的近战或远程攻击若造成超过最大生命值 8%% 的伤害，则会降低 %d%% 伤害，并触发一次半径为 %d 的扇形爆炸，造成 %d%% 蒸汽枪伤害。剩余 %d 层叠加。

entries.source:
These boots seem to have been made by a... creative individual who seems to have decided that launching yourself through the air via rocketry qualifies as "anti-gravity".
They look like they will work, though.
Probably.
If you're very careful.
entries.target:
这套鞋子似乎是被一位具有……创造力的大师制造出来的，他似乎认为用火箭将你发射到空中就是“反重力”了。
不过看上去这套鞋子能用。
大概吧。
只要你非常非常小心。

entries.source: This yeti is large and angry, with claws far more sharply honed than those found in nature.
entries.target: 这个雪人体型巨大、怒气冲冲，它的爪子打磨得远比野生雪人的锋利。

entries.source:
You replace your steamgun and attack with a multi-barreled bolt launcher, firing deadly chemical-infused flechettes.
		
		Each attack fires twice for %d%% weapon damage as acid and generates %d steam per hit.
entries.target:
你把你的蒸汽枪替换成一把多管重型枪械，发射注入致命化学物质的子弹。

		每次攻击造成两次 %d%% 酸性武器伤害，击中恢复 %d 蒸汽。

entries.source: This abomination has the height of any other titan but its feature definitively remind you of the few Sher'Tul images you have seen. Your very being rebels to the thought and sheer terror takes hold of your mind.
entries.target: 这个孽物和其他泰坦差不多高，但是他的特征让你回想起了你见过的那些夏·图尔人图片。你竭尽全力地抗拒这些想法，你的心灵已被纯粹的恐惧所控制。

entries.source:
Instantly channel all of your remaining steam to replenish your psi energies and either enhance your active psionic damage shield or trigger a new one.
		The (new or existing) shield duration is increased by 3 turns and its power is boosted by %d%% of the steam used.
		You restore psi equal to %d%% of the steam used.
		This talent requires Gestalt to be active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown.
entries.target:
瞬间引导你剩余的所有蒸汽来补充你的灵能并强化已激活的精神护盾或制造一个新的精神护盾。
		护盾的持续时间会增加 3 回合，并能额外吸收相当于所消耗蒸汽量 %d%% 的伤害。
		你回复相当于所消耗蒸汽量 %d%% 的灵能。
		此技能需要格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中。
